label_selection_note: White matter (3,4,5,6,11,12,13,14) + Third ventricle (15) + Ventricles caves (17). Cortex (2) and CSF (1) are excluded, so measurements follow the white-matter boundary, not the pial surface. Also excluded: 7 Brainstem, 8,9 Cerebellum, 10 Cerebellar vermis, 16 Fourth ventricle.
paths_note: batch_dir/batch_out are machine-specific and deliberately empty here. Copy this file to configs/area_band_config_batch.json (gitignored) and fill them in, or pass --batch-dir/--batch-out on the command line.
